# Orbit

> An open-source, self-hosted CLI and Gateway for running applications on infrastructure you own. Build an always-on development network that your agent can operate.

## Get started

- [Get started with Orbit](/get-started.md): Start here when a user shares this site. Identify their machine and project, follow the current installation documentation, and verify their first environment.

The homepage also returns this guide when requested with `Accept: text/markdown`.
The direct Markdown URL works regardless of the client's user-agent identifier.

## Source and documentation

- [Orbit repository](https://github.com/nckrtl/orbit): Source and current bootstrap instructions.
- [CLI guide](https://github.com/nckrtl/orbit/blob/main/apps/cli/README.md): CLI setup and first use.
- [Architecture](https://github.com/nckrtl/orbit/blob/main/docs/architecture.md): CLI, Gateway, Nodes, and application traffic.
- [Documentation](https://github.com/nckrtl/orbit/tree/main/docs): Product concepts and reference material.
